company.description:
BoldVoice is a communication coaching app that helps non-native speakers improve their communication and confidence. The company's application helps foreign-born professionals and students in the US to improve their English accents via hyper-personalized content, enabling them to improve their English language pronunciation and confidence via personalized content from Hollywood's top accent coaches

BoldVoice was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile English communication coaching app for non-native speakers, combining American accent lessons, personalized practice plans, pronunciation exercises, progress tracking, and speech AI feedback.
productsAndServices.name: BoldVoice App

productsAndServices.description: A business communication training offering that helps organizations provide English pronunciation, accent, and speaking-confidence training to non-native English-speaking employees.

productsAndServices.description: Private accent coaching sessions with a professional speech or dialect coach, providing individualized pronunciation guidance and targeted feedback alongside app-based practice.
